authorization_basis: The project owner authorized limited local ComfyUI/Ollama start and probe, approved non-private samples, and confirmed the pre-existing ComfyUI was closed.
Read-only clearance showed no target PID/listener and 1530 MiB Windows/WSL GPU usage.
Reusable harness 82975aefdef2df84d6ec89285f3c450a47d78d89 passed 19 deterministic tests and is sealed by receipt commit 2f8ac303bcae93ebf93dde449ade246f11bceff5.
route_attempt_policy: second and final effective attempt for this unchanged product candidate and live route

allowed.pre_service_gate: Windows-native/WSL GPU total equal, used/free delta <=128 MiB, each native used <=4096 MiB, no target Comfy/Ollama process, no 8191/11434 listener
allowed.ollama: Windows-native per-process OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 wrapper, literal loopback only
allowed.pre_model_gate: OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD:true plus at least 10 seconds and 5 samples with zero owned non-loopback TCP
allowed.comfy: fresh run-owned Windows temp base, sealed product candidate, 127.0.0.1:8191

forbidden: product candidate, harness candidate, semantic oracle, contract, timeout or threshold changes
manual process termination outside run-owned PIDs
firewall, registry, hosts-file or permanent environment changes
cloud or paid provider calls, downloads or upgrades
permanent target installation writes, visible browser startup or remote Git push
mandatory_stops: no-cloud or remote-TCP pre-model gate failure
unknown listener/GPU owner or model/sample/candidate mismatch
GPU memory reaches or exceeds 23552 MiB
any per-call or final cleanup/target-integrity gap
cleanup: after each started model call require keep_alive=0 correlation and terminal /api/ps empty; stop owned wrapper/listener PIDs; prove ports empty; remove run-owned temp; verify target integrity
expires_when: WP-S0-20 produces one terminal receipt or either single effective media attempt is consumed
